# STX — Catalysts

## TL;DR

The Q3 FY26 print landed Apr 28 2026. Next scheduled catalyst is the Q4 FY26 print (late July / early August 2026). Between now and then, watch hyperscaler capex updates, Mozaic qualification news, and supply commentary.

> _This is bootstrap context dated 2026-05-01. The runtime swing routine must do its own fresh research and indicator analysis; do not anchor to anything stated here._

## Upcoming events

- **Q4 FY26 earnings** — late July / early August 2026 (typical Seagate cadence; exact date pending company confirmation). Guide: $3.45B ± $100M revenue, EPS ~$5.00, operating margin in the low-40s%.
- **Mozaic 4 ramp milestones** — management said Mozaic 4 will be the majority of HAMR exabyte shipments exiting calendar 2026. Watch for mid-cycle qualification or shipment data points (Motley Fool transcript, Apr 28 2026).
- **Mozaic 5 (50TB) qualification** — targeted late 2027; any earlier sample-shipment news is a data point.
- **Hyperscaler capex updates** — MSFT/META/GOOGL/AMZN earnings cycles read through to STX as second-derivative data-center spend signals.

## Recent news synthesis

- **Q3 FY26 print (Apr 28 2026)**: Revenue $3.1B (+44% YoY), non-GAAP EPS $4.10, FCF $953M, non-GAAP gross margin 47% (+180 bps QoQ). Annual revenue growth target raised to ≥20% (BusinessWire, Apr 28 2026).
- **Sold-out commentary (Apr 30 2026)**: Multiple outlets report nearline capacity allocated through calendar 2027; data center is 87% of shipments. AI-driven HDD ASPs reportedly +50% (Trefis / Yahoo Finance, Apr 30; Winbuzzer, Feb 2026).
- **Mozaic adoption**: Two of the largest CSPs qualified on the 4TB-per-disk product; Mozaic shipped to 75% of leading global cloud customers (Motley Fool transcript, Apr 28 2026).

## Insider activity

Per GuruFocus / Yahoo Finance insider feeds: 140 insider transactions in the trailing 6 months — all sales, zero open-market purchases. ~$46.9M sold in the trailing 3 months. CEO William D. Mosley sold ~144,584 shares (~$51M) across 90 transactions. Many filings are likely 10b5-1 dispositions; raw ratio is reported here without interpretation.

## Analyst consensus

Recent PT actions post-earnings: Rosenblatt $1,000 (raised from $500, Apr 29 2026), Bank of America $840 (from $700), Barclays $750 (from $625), Citi $740 (from $595), Goldman Sachs $700 (from $385). Stock close $726.93 on 2026-05-01 sits above all PTs ex-Rosenblatt (24/7 Wall St., Apr 29 2026).

## Last updated

2026-05-01 — bootstrap run. Sources: BusinessWire, Motley Fool, Trefis, 24/7 Wall St., GuruFocus, Winbuzzer, Yahoo Finance.
